body.statement:
Let \(X_{-\gamma}\in\operatorname{PP}_{\mathcal S,L}(Y_0)\).  If the strongly connected component of \(Y\) in \(\mathcal S\) is \(\{Y\}\) and no summary bidirected edge joins \(Y\) to a directed ancestor of \(Y\), then the controlled micro direct effect, in every compatible full-time causal graph, equals
\[
\mathbb E_p[Y_0\mid X_{-\gamma}=1,Z=z]-\mathbb E_p[Y_0\mid X_{-\gamma}=0,Z=z],
\qquad
Z=\operatorname{PP}_{\mathcal S,L}(Y_0)\setminus\{X_{-\gamma}\}.
\]

attestation.note: Checked against Theorem 9 in the authors' preprint and the final PMLR publication record.
